language.title: Language
language.hint: The language this harness speaks — written to config.edn, and the same one the model is told to answer in. The harness's own sentences (tool results, errors) are not translated.

panel.title: Settings
panel.errorNote: A configuration that cannot be resolved is shown instead of the values — the files are still yours to fix.

defaults.title: Default tier
defaults.introLead: What a new session starts from —
defaults.introTail: . This session may be listening to its own choice instead; the rows above say which.
defaults.inlineNote: Three selects cannot express that. Choosing a vendor below replaces the description with a named one.
defaults.modelHint: One of this vendor's models. The vendor's own default is preselected.
defaults.errorNote: Nothing was written — the tier still holds what it held.

models.title: Providers
models.withoutKeys_one: {{count}} provider has no key — open to add one
models.withoutKeys_other: {{count}} providers have no key — open to add one
models.withoutKeysHint: A provider with no key cannot serve a run, so it is not offered above. Add its key and it moves back into the list.

form.providerIdEditingHint: Renaming means removing this entry and adding another: the id is what the request names and what the credential in .env is derived from.
form.providerIdHint: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes, starting with a letter. It names this vendor in requests and derives its credential name in .env.
form.apiKeyEditingHint: Leave empty to keep the line in .env as it is. A value replaces it.
form.apiKeyHint: Written to the home's .env as its own line, named after the id. Never sent back to this page.
form.firstTail: model is this vendor's own default — what a run lands on when no tier names one. Which model a session actually starts on is set in General, not here.
form.noModels: A vendor must declare at least one model: an entry with no models cannot be selected, so offering it would be offering a refusal.
form.fetchNoAddress: Fill in an API address first
form.fetchTitle: Ask the vendor what it serves
form.offeredHint: Tick what you want in the catalog. Each arrives declaring text only — raise it if the vendor takes images.
form.errorNote: Nothing was written — config.edn is exactly as it was.
form.removeTitle: Takes this entry out of config.edn. config.edn.bak holds the file as it was, and the .env line stays.
form.limitsNote: Reported, not enforced. Omit what you have not verified.
form.instructionUpdatesLabel: How this model receives a moved instruction

mcp.heading: MCP servers
mcp.introLead: Outside programs this session was asked to hand tools to. Declared in
mcp.introTail: — this page reads that and changes nothing about it.
mcp.emptyLead: No servers are declared for this session. Declare one in
mcp.notUsable: — not usable as a tool name

subagents.title: Subagents
subagents.builtinNote: A built-in comes from the code, so it cannot be removed. Saving here writes an override with its name to {{file}}.
subagents.fileNote: That file is rewritten whole when this form saves, and what it held before is kept beside it.
subagents.name: Name
subagents.nameHint: How the main agent asks for it. Letters, digits and dashes.
subagents.editingNameHint: The name is what the main agent asks for, so renaming means adding another and removing this one.
subagents.descriptionHint: The main agent reads this when it decides who to hand work to: say what it is good at, and when it is the right one.
subagents.baselineHint: A range is a baseline plus exclusions. There is no field that puts a tool back: eval and the delegating tool are never served to any subagent.
subagents.excludeHint: Comma-separated tool names. In force on the next delegation — nothing restarts.
subagents.removeTitle: Takes this entry out of harness.edn. What the file held before is kept beside it.
subagents.errorNote: Nothing was written — harness.edn is exactly as it was.
subagents.problemLead: harness.edn's :subagents block says something that could not be honoured:
subagents.problemTail: The built-ins are still what this session uses.
